title: Membrane Filter

introduction.definition: A plate-and-frame membrane filter clamps flat-sheet membranes between support plates. Feed under pressure flows across the membrane surfaces (cross-flow); the liquid that passes through (permeate) drains from each plate, while the concentrated retentate leaves at the end of the stack.
introduction.summary: A plate-and-frame membrane filter stacks flat-sheet membranes between support plates. Feed under pressure sweeps across the membrane surfaces (cross-flow); permeate passes through and drains from each plate, while the concentrated retentate leaves at the end. A hydraulic cylinder clamps the stack.

pressure.title: Trans-membrane pressure drives permeation
pressure.description: Feed is held at pressure on one side of each membrane (red); permeate leaves at near-atmospheric pressure (blue). The trans-membrane pressure (TMP) pushes liquid through the pores, while the feed sweeps across the surface (cross-flow) to limit the fouling layer.

video_tutorials.title: Membrane Filter — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Membrane Filter.
A plate-and-frame membrane filter clamps flat-sheet membranes between support plates.
Feed under pressure flows across the membrane surfaces (cross-flow); the liquid that passes through (permeate) drains from each plate, while the concentrated retentate leaves at the end of the stack.
Typical applications include dairy and food concentration; pharmaceutical and biotech clarification; industrial wastewater and leachate treatment.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Membrane Filter — Operation

script.narration: How the Membrane Filter works.
Feed enters through the fixed head.
It sweeps across the membranes between the plates.
Permeate passes through and drains from each plate.
The hydraulic cylinder clamps the stack.
Retentate leaves at the head.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Feed is held at pressure on one side of each membrane (red); permeate leaves at near-atmospheric pressure (blue).

video_tutorials.title: Membrane Filter — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Membrane Filter.
Monitor flux, TMP and permeate quality.
CIP cleaning.
Replace membranes.
Watch for flux decline: lower permeate rate. Common cause: fouling, scaling.
Watch for leak: feed in permeate. Common cause: damaged membrane/gasket.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
